request: Stage current DebugAI PR112 within registered parent nested owned worktree and verify Gate regression; no production deployment.

bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; r=/home/admin1/projects/debug-ai; p="$r/.worktrees/pr112-gates-20261016"; test "$(git -C "$r" rev-parse --show-toplevel)" = "$r"; test -d "$r/.worktrees"; test ! -L "$p"; git -C "$r" remote get-url origin | grep -Eq '(^https://github.com/seigo-gace/debug-ai(\\.git)?$|^git@github.com:seigo-gace/debug-ai(\\.git)?$)' || exit 21; git -C "$r" fetch --no-tags origin refs/heads/feat/debugai-core-gate-preflight-20261014; test "$(git -C "$r" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "bb08aef1d92271d1fb4ab9f37309535811d48180" || exit 22; if test ! -e "$p"; then git -C "$r" worktree add --detach "$p" "bb08aef1d92271d1fb4ab9f37309535811d48180"; fi; test "$(git -C "$p" rev-parse HEAD)" = "bb08aef1d92271d1fb4ab9f37309535811d48180" || exit 23; test -z "$(git -C "$p" status --porcelain)" || exit 24; cd "$p"; timeout 50s node --test server/tests/ai-core-gate-preflight.test.cjs >/tmp/debugai-pr112-preflight-test.log 2>&1; rc=$?; test "$rc" -eq 0 || { tail -n 8 /tmp/debugai-pr112-preflight-test.log; exit "$rc"; }
